paper_title: Piezoelectrically Tuned Multimode Cavity Search for Axion Dark Matter
notes: ADMX Sidecar pathfinder experiment reports 90% CL exclusion limits on axion-photon coupling g_agamma in three frequency bands: Run A (4202–4249 MHz, 17.38–17.57 µeV, TM010 mode), Run B (5086–5799 MHz, 21.03–23.98 µeV, TM010 mode), and Run C (7173–7203 MHz, 29.67–29.79 µeV, TM020 mode). Data points extracted from Figure 4 (top panels) showing approximate coupling limits at the edges of each scanned mass range. The experiment assumes dark matter axion density ρ_a = 0.45 GeV/cm³ with isothermal halo distribution. Run B was a low-field commissioning run (0.78 T nominal, 2.55 T for final 3 days); Runs A and C used 3.11 T. The TM020 mode (Run C) suffers from a weaker form factor (~0.04–0.046 vs ~0.49 for TM010) leading to ~4× loss in expected axion power. Limits exclude previously unexplored parameter space for axion-like particles and improve on solar bounds by ~2 orders of magnitude under 100% dark matter assumption, though do not yet reach DFSZ sensitivity. | selector: text (sole candidate)
